name: routeless
description: Routeless: The Last Mile - Simulation and optimizer platform for rural student transit

scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.warmup: node -e "fetch(process.env.BACKEND_URL || 'http://localhost:3001/api/health').then(r=>r.json()).then(d=>console.log('Warmup probe response:', d)).catch(e=>console.error('Warmup probe failed:', e.message))"
